# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B26

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

Metadata lists the temperature column without stating its measurement status.
According to the README the charge capacity accumulator restarts with every step.
The experiment logs discrete events rather than intervals for voltage; sampling-point questions therefore do not apply.
Laboratory notes record inclusive bounds on both sides for the current interval.
An index marker for cycle index is present yet the encoding scheme remains unspecified.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

Deposit description specifies the dataset state procedure exclusively as step_type_column.
The deposit omits the voltage channel entirely; unit declarations for it are consequently undefined.
The data dictionary records that the discharge capacity channel is transformed by affine(1.5, 0.5).

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B26 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B26.
